content.title: Power Integrations (POWI): Net Margin Drops to 7.6%, Challenging Bullish Community Growth Narratives
content.summary: Power Integrations (POWI) reported that revenue is forecast to grow at 12.4% per year, topping the projected 10.5% annual pace for the overall US market. However, the company’s net profit margin slipped to 7.6%, down from 10.4% a year ago, and its earnings have dropped 28% per year over the past five years, signaling a period of ongoing profit contraction. content.title: POWI Q3 Deep Dive: Appliance Slowdown Weighs on Guidance as Industrial, Data Center Initiatives Advance
content.summary: Semiconductor designer Power Integrations (NASDAQ:POWI) met Wall Streets revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 2.7% year on year to $118.9 million. On the other hand, next quarter’s revenue guidance of $102.5 million was less impressive, coming in 11.5% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.36 per share was 4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
